degree_rationale: Stratifies the Darkness into Five Worlds with their five archon-kings, five elements, five trees, five bodies. Mirrors teaching 5 — the essence-map of the dark side, with detailed iconography of the King of Darkness's body (lion-head, eagle-wings, etc.).
direction_rationale: Foundational counter-mapping of the dark realm parallel to the light's structure. Still in the originating-declarative mode of essence-laying.
grand_man_function: The five-fold dark counter-inmost — the cardinal contraries to the celestial Faces.
title: How darkness stratifies into Five Worlds with their kings and elements
